title: Receiver accepts a bare token in the Authorization header (no 'Bearer ' scheme)
evidence: Integration test probe: POST /chunk with Origin chrome-extension://a*32 and header 'Authorization: <token>' (no scheme) returned 200 and was written. A token holder with the right origin is already authorised, so this is leniency not a bypass; the token and extension-origin checks still apply.
fix_direction: Require the exact 'Bearer ' prefix before comparing (reject when absent).

title: tab-browser.test.ts 'owned status ... refuses corrupt identity' fails on this Windows machine: symlinkSync EPERM (no symlink privilege)
evidence: node --test --import tsx src/capture/tab-browser.test.ts -> 12 pass 1 fail, twice (EPERM: operation not permitted, symlink). Pre-existing, file untouched by this unit; environmental (Windows without Developer Mode/admin), passes on Linux CI.
fix_direction: Skip the symlink assertion when symlinkSync throws EPERM.
